description: Two annotation layers for the Svelte 5 data grid. A column-level tooltip, static or computed from the cell context, renders as a native title so hovering any cell in that column explains it; and per-cell notes passed as a { [rowId]: { [columnId]: string } } map through the notes prop paint a corner indicator and use the note text as the hover tooltip. You own the storage, the grid renders the indicator; a button adds, edits or deletes the note on the selected cell.

faq.question: How do I add a tooltip to a column?
faq.answer: Set tooltip on the column definition, either a string or a function of the cell context that returns one. The grid writes it as the cell's title attribute.

faq.question: How are notes stored?
faq.answer: In your own state as an object keyed by row id and then column id. Pass it as the notes prop; when the user saves a note you update the object and the indicator appears on that cell.

faq.question: Do notes survive sorting and filtering?
faq.answer: Yes. They are keyed by row id rather than row index, so a note stays on its record wherever the row moves.
